原文: A historical account of the enslavement of Giants in Thaermore, by Mars Birchun. *The giants of Tharemore, now predominately residing in the Timberland Plains area, are not native to the region of Thaermore. It was the enslavement of these beings for work in the mines that brought them here. *First, a note concerning Giants: they are not the feeble-minded creatures of popular conception. They are, in fact, highly socialized beings equal to that of men or elves, though perhaps their primitive speech patterns and rituals make them appear less civilized. It was this prejudice that led to the giants' enslavement and eventual revolt of the race of giants. *During the late second century, great multitudes of giants were brought from the lands beyond Barrea and forced to work the mines, smashing rock and carrying ore. Their captors thought of them as nothing more than animals and worked them often to their death. However, as their numbers increased, the giants began to secretly organize a rebellion. By the time their captors knew of this plot, the giants had grown too numerous and unified to be suppressed. The revolt of 477 was a bloody uprising that ended with the freedom of the enslaved giants. Hundreds of humans were killed in the rebellion. *Although many to this day harbor ill feelings towards the giants, others now acknowledge the giant's right to freedom and no longer hold them responsible for the bloodshed incurred during the revolt. The giants themselves remain suspicious of humans and choose to stay in the lands they claimed after the revolt, though their numbers have steadily dwindled as many have left to return to their native homelands.

原文: $, *Well done! If you are reading this then you have completed a difficult series of tasks designed to ensure your safety. Although enough time has passed for you to have firmly solidified your new identity, the danger surrounding your previous identity is not completely eliminated. Still, it should be a bit safer now to fill you in on some of the mystery surrounding your past. *First, you undoubtedly see the large gemstone in the box along with this note. Yes, this is the legendary "Crux of Ages" that I'm sure you have heard about. Take it with you and keep it close. It will protect you, but if you show it to anyone it will certainly lead to your death. *Now for how this came into your possession: you found it while scavenging a goblin battlefield looking for valuables. I cannot describe the details of the actual discovery to you now because if it were to trigger memories of the event, your life would be in certain danger. Let me explain: *A powerful Goblin Shaman named Gramuk is using a technique called "Temporal Linking" to locate the person who recovered the Crux. You see, every action you do is etched in your mind as a memory, forever linked to a lifetime of previously accumulated memories. Thus, the event of you finding the Crux was linked to all the memories associated with your prior identity. Scryers who perform Temporal Linking can use these linked memories to identify and locate people by focusing in on specific events. Erasing your identity and all associated memories means Gramuk is unable to connect the event of recovering the gemstone back to you. Even after taking possession of the Crux now, the lack of chronological memories linking you to the gem means it will be many weeks before Gramuk will be able to scry enough information to locate you. *So have you figured out who I am yet? Certainly you must have speculated by now that I am you. Yes, you set this all up to protect yourself- you wrote these notes and devised this scheme to destroy your memory and build a new identity. *Now this is where things get complicated and I will do my best to help you understand what is happening. First, you were not alone when you found the Crux: your brother was with you and shared in the recovery and concealment of the gemstone. He had planned to erase his memory along with you, but he was located and captured by the Goblins before he was able to complete the task. The only chance you had of helping him was to follow through with the plan and erase your own memory first. Now that you've accomplished this, you must locate and help your brother. The Goblins will keep him alive as long as they believe they can extract information from him, but the torture he must be enduring is unthinkable. Days ago, just before you erased your memory, you heard from a Ranger passing through Tanglewood that he may have been taken to the abandoned city Vela, which is now a goblin outpost. *There are many more questions surrounding this war, such as the Chancellor believing that the Orakur have stolen the gem even though evidence strongly points to the Goblins. This evidence, along with the Chancellor's incongruous war plan to abandon security across Thaermore, substantiates the theory that Gramuk is somehow influencing the Chancellor. While you may believe none of this information concerns you, it does, because eventually the Crux will be tracked back to you; eventually your brother will be killed when he is of no more use to the Goblins; and eventually all of Thaermore will fall to the spreading Goblin insurgence. Like it or not, you have become a significant factor in this war. *If you fled now, I wouldn't blame you. You could toss the gem into a river, leave your brother whom you have no memories of to his fate and start a new life somewhere else. However, I know you are stronger person than that. Please, locate and help your brother. He is the only family you have.

Thus, the event of you finding the Crux was linked to all the memories associated with your prior identity. Please, locate and help your brother. He is the only family you have.

原文: This hefty tome recounts the early years of Thaermore's history in exhausting detail. Thankfully, the first chapter is an abridged timeline of events covered within the book. *CHAPTER 1 : An abridgment of historical events concerning Thaermore, eastern province of Eschalon. *--- *Year 390 - Dwarven explorer Koru Keyhammer reaches the Eastern lands known as Thaermore and reports of vast natural resources and deposits of gold, ore and gemstones. *Year 405 - The first permanent settlement called "Loneloft" is established in the mountains of western Thaermore; its founders are primarily miners and surveyors. *Year 409 - Loneloft settlers report they have encountered a peaceful race of subterranean peoples known as the Orakur. They are described as Dwarvish in build but more adapted for permanent life underground, with large eyes and little hair. *Year 419 - Skirmishes arise over control of the mines as the Orakur claim the settlers are stealing minerals from what they refer to as the "Great Underground". By Year 423 these small skirmishes had escalated into war, later to be called The Plague Wars. Dwarven settlers sign an accord absolving themselves from warring with Orakur because of a perceived kinship. Because of this accord, the Dwarven people abandon their claims and leave Thaermore; Thaermore forever becomes predominately occupied by the race of Men. *Year 425 - While mining for copper a settler named Sam of Thorabur discovers a massive gemstone that would become known as "The Crux of Ages". Because of the ongoing conflict with the Orukur the rough stone is hidden away in Bastion Spire, a stronghold which would later become the capitol of Thaermore. *Year 433 - The first governing body of Thaermore is formed. It was decreed that a lifetime Chancellor would be elected to represent the will of people. He is given the highest authority and has a council of twelve advisors, known as The Grand Scholars, serve with him. *435 - Chancellor Marr is elected as the first governor of Thaermore. Under his leadership, Thaermore establishes the Commonwealth Guard, which becomes the turning point in the war with the Orakur. *444 - The Orakur are suppressed and driven deep underground. Chancellor Marr declares victory in the war. The Orakur disappear completely and many assume the whole populous must have succumbed to disease or starvation. Dwarven Lords from outside Thaermore condemn Chancellor Marr for his unethical warfare tactics; relations between the race of Dwarves and Men are fractured. *471 - Chancellor Marr dies after 36 years of distinguished service. Chancellor Marr II, later known as "The Great One", superseded his father as Chancellor. This officially begins the golden age of expansion and prosperity for Thaermore. *509 - Chancellor Torrus I supersedes Chancellor Marr II. *537 - Chancellor Katerra I supersedes Chancellor Torrus I. *[There is an entry here that has been blackened out by ink] *590 - Goblin skirmishes arise in Crakamir. The Chancellor, unwilling to squander resources defending a wasteland, concedes Crakamir to the Goblins. Elsewhere in Thaermore, the Commonwealth Guard is successful in eliminating the Goblin threat. *627 - A devastating earthquake shakes the eastern province, tearing great rifts into the land. The Orakur, long believed to have been decimated, reappear from the great fissures. Surveyors who spot them claimed they appeared skittish and non-hostile. Elusive and rarely seen above ground, the reappearance of the Orakur is not considered a threat and they are all but forgotten. *The timeline ends here, although it looks like the following page may have been ripped from the book.

原文: "Goblin Clans of Thaermore" *Goblins have always been a nuisance to the people of the eastern provinces. Like weeds and mosquitoes, it was a common acceptance that goblins were just here to annoy us, mucking around and causing trouble. Luckily the common goblin is just that- a nuisance that is easily scared away when confronted. Early settlers learned that just keeping a dog nearby or a lantern lit was usually enough to keep the Goblins from stealing chickens at night. *This changed in the late 5th century when Goblins began to organize themselves into clans. Suddenly there appeared Goblin war units capable of causing great harm to others. They stopped being a nuisance and became a danger. During the skirmishes of 590, the Commonwealth Guard experienced noted difficulty in suppressing Goblin raids in the southlands. After securing most of Thaermore, a large wall called the Southern Gate was built to keep the Goblins contained in Crakamir. Human settlers were evacuated from the desert lands. The Chancellor proclaimed it a victory for humans; the Goblins clans claimed it a victory for themselves. *Much was learned of the Goblin war clans at that time. The basic warrior, called the Goblin Hacker, uses a short sword or machete in a savage but effective attack. Goblin Archers have been witnessed to have impressive accuracy with short bows. And the Goblin Bombthug, a unit strapped with a keg of Bangdust, is fully prepared to sacrifice himself in the defense of the unit or a higher officer. Although most Goblins are not known to possess magickal abilities, there are reports of Goblin Shaman among the clan population. *The Goblin unit is loosely assembled and generally led by a Warlord. Warlords answer to a higher officer, usually the clan leader. "Clan leader" is a position held by the strongest goblin; at any time the leader may be challenged and overthrown by a more powerful Goblin.

原文: Jak notched an arrow and pulled the string back until he felt that familiar feeling of feathers against his cheek. At that moment he realized he is only at peace when his arm is burning to keep a bow drawn; when he is looking down the shaft of what will be certain death for the next person to enter his sight. *This bow was heavier than what he was used to, with at least 30 pounds more draw. That didn't matter. He felt so focused and alert that he probably could have held twice that additional weight and still have enough accuracy to put the arrow through someone's eye at 100 yards. All the anger and vengeance he had been carrying with him for years was now forgotten. This was the moment he had waited half a lifetime for and he was going to savor every second of it. *In the darkness, far off over the grassy hill that marked the extent of the outpost's defendable area, a soft orange glow appeared on the horizon. Pinpoints of flickering torchlight slowly rose over the crest of the knoll, signifying the approach of an army that was coming to wage war upon the outpost. The front line stretched more than a half-mile wide and through the ground Jak could feel the footsteps of an entire legion of soldiers approaching. 'All this just for me?' he thought to himself as his pressed lips formed into a smile, the first in many years. 'You did not bring nearly enough men with you, dear father.'

原文: Benny knew he shouldn't keep it. If his mother or father found it, they would dash it upon the ground without a second thought and probably give him a lashing that he wouldn't forget for months. *Still, it was beautiful. Dense and leathery, the egg was pleasing to cradle in Benny's arms. It seemed to produce its own warmth, and occasionally Benny felt something inside move. The colors on the egg changed as well, from a spotted purple appearance in the sunlight to a deep green when indoors. And in the darkest of conditions, Benny swore he could see the egg glow faintly from within. Two nights in a row he slept with it under his blankets and it gave him much happiness. He held it close and talked to it, reassuring the egg that he would not let any harm come to it. *By the end of the week Benny noticed a change in the egg. Its shell grew thinner and more flexible, and whatever was inside seemed to grow more restless. Fearful still to tell his parents but having no intention of getting rid of it, he instead kept the egg under his bed in a wooden box filled with straw while he tended the field with his father during the day. This seemed to be a good solution at first, but on the second day Benny returned home to discover something startling had occurred while he was away...

原文: Eschalon, A World of Wonder *Although many dispute the origins of our great world, none can argue its splendor and diversity. Eschalon is divided into 5 great Provinces, with each Province consisting of multiple regions: *The Province of Thaermore, in the east, consists of temperate climates, rolling hills and dense woodlands. While known mostly for its beautiful coastal regions, it also features deserts in the south. Mistfell is the most populated Province in all of Eschalon and has more cities than any other Province. *The far Western shores of Eschalon belong to Province of Barrea, a harsh wasteland known as The Desolation. This largely uncharted area is known to be home to mercenary clans and giants. The most remote areas of the wasteland are said to be home to colossal beasts. *The far northern region of Eschalon is called the Northland Expanse, an arctic Province of snowy tundra, frozen mountains, and glacial valleys. *The southern Province of Eschalon is called the Rift Zone, a volcanic area of great fissures and rivers of magma. In areas where the volcanoes are dormant and the brimstone has cooled, lush jungles have spread.

原文: You open your eyes. Your head is aching and you immediately realize you have no idea where you are. The only thing you can remember about last night is the terrible storm; the black of night cut with flashes of lightning. *Then you remember something- movement in the darkness. A shadowy presence. Slowly you begin to realize that you have no memory of anything before the storm of last evening. In fact, you have no idea who you even are!
